name: Ocoya
shortDescription: Social content plans from $29 per month, with a 7-day trial.
longDescription: Ocoya's pricing page lists a Starter plan at $29 per month billed monthly for independent creators, and a 7-day free trial that requires a card. Higher plans were also listed.
pricingNotes: Starter is $29 per month billed monthly, with a 7-day free trial that requires a card.
bestFor: Creating and scheduling social content on a listed monthly plan
notIdealFor: Someone who wants a trial without a card
strength: Ocoya lists a Starter plan at $29 per month and a 7-day free trial that requires a card.
weakness: The trial requires a card, and higher plans cost $79 and $199 per month.
